objective: Carry the A3 transonic adjoint up the reopened ladder by deliberate conditioning: measure the assembled operator's diagonal spread at the next rung, choose the preconditioner from that diagnosis and from the iterative-methods theory rather than by trying knobs, pre-register which choice the diagnosis implies, and then run it
rationale: The strategy names A3 as the proof case for linear solvers and preconditioning, and the honest reading of the record is that the ladder reopened without the proof being earned. The 21,840-cell rung now converges: the objective adjoint reaches its relative tolerance in 368 iterations and the second objective in 383, at 7.33 core-minutes of wall, and the negative control reproduces the archived failure bit for bit from the same starting state including the terminal denormal, so identical state and opposite outcomes turn on one token. But that token was a dead-code discovery, not a diagnosis: the archived runs set a transonic preconditioner option whose only value the compressible steady solver implements is the other one, so every archived attempt ran with the option inert. That is knob-luck with an excellent audit trail, and it is exactly what the proof clause excludes. The diagnostic half already exists and has never been used to choose anything. The assembled preconditioner matrix at that rung is 200,360 by 200,360 with 22,017,324 nonzeros, its diagonal spans 14.17 decades, turning residual normalisation off makes the spread worse at 16.14 decades and changes the failure signature from denormal breakdown to honest stagnation, strengthening the fill level and running nested Richardson both fail by collapsing to zero exactly at the restart boundary, and the colouring counts do not discriminate converging from diverging cases. Against that, the incompressible case whose adjoint converges under complete sub-block factorisation has a spread of 8.67 decades. So the lab has a measured conditioning coordinate with a converging and a diverging exemplar on either side of it, and has never once predicted from it. The reopened ladder asks whether the transonic option alone carries the taller rungs at 42,120, 79,560 and 99,840 cells, and it is the right place to make the prediction first. The memory envelope is part of the prediction, not an excuse: the converging rung's stock run held 5,876.6 mebibytes, so the next rung sits near the container cap and a memory wall reached before the conditioning question is answered is a pre-registered outcome rather than a surprise. Axis A: reading-kind, priced from the same rung's measured adjoint. Axis B: 0, no wall row moves. Axis C: 0.

cost_basis: measured on this family: the converged 21,840-cell adjoint cost 110 seconds of wall, 7.33 core-min, at 368 iterations, and its negative control 8.53 core-min; the 42,120-cell rung is 1.93 times the cells, so one diagnosis dump plus one predicted-preconditioner arm plus one control scales to about 35 core-min at the same rank count, with the container memory cap named as the binding risk rather than the walltime
expected_knowledge_gain: The lab either gains a conditioning predictor or refutes one, and both are usable. Outcome one: the diagnosis predicts the taller rung needs more than the transonic option, a stronger preconditioner is chosen on that basis, and the adjoint converges, which is the proof clause satisfied and a rule that transfers to every future transonic adjoint. Outcome two: the diagnosis predicts the transonic option suffices and it does, which is a weaker but still deliberate result and makes the spread coordinate predictive across two rungs. Outcome three: the prediction fails, which kills the diagonal-spread coordinate as a preconditioner selector and says so, and that is worth more than another knob sweep. Outcome four: the rung hits the memory cap before the conditioning question resolves, which is pre-registered and moves the item to the memory envelope rather than leaving a silent gap.
sequencing: Ride-along under strategy rule 4: it rides the reopened A3 ladder, which is standing family work. Subordinate to the Ladder V queue under rule 1.
gate: STRATEGY PROOF CLAUSE, verbatim: 'Linear solvers & preconditioning: Saad (Iterative Methods, open PDF) working group -> PROOF: A3's transonic adjoint conditioned deliberately (diagonal-spread diagnosis -> chosen preconditioner -> converged), not by knob-luck.' Operationalised as an ordered chain that must be walked in order and pre-registered before the arm runs: (1) dump the assembled preconditioner matrix at the next rung and report its diagonal, row and column spreads against the 14.17 decades measured at the converging rung and the 8.67 decades of the converging incompressible case; (2) from that diagnosis and from the stated theory, name one preconditioner and state, in writing, why it is implied and what convergence behaviour is predicted; (3) run exactly that configuration, changing nothing else; (4) grade the prediction. A run whose configuration was chosen after the diagnosis was read but not written down, or whose preconditioner was changed mid-arm, fails the clause however well it converges.
